title: I built an online playground where Claude can make SNES games
author: shiny_guruw
selftext:
I have been having so much fun with this.

I created [ppu.toys](http://ppu.toys) as a playground for myself (and maybe others) to toy around and play with the graphical capabilities of the Super Nintendo. Think [ShaderToy](https://www.shadertoy.com/) but if it was made in the 90s.

I took the project way further than I initially planned. The site now emulates the ppu (the picture processing unit) and the SNES sound chip, and it ships a Lua -> 65816 compiler, so the creations now actually run on real hardware!

Recently, I added an MCP server which gives Claude full control over the studio and the results have been frankly incredible. Claude imports its own art, writes all the game logic, composes music, and even playtests all through the MCP. The studio enforces all the constraints of the old hardware. Color and background limits and also enables your coding agent to take full advantage of features including Mode 7!

I created the video as a way to capture and share the joy this creation is bringing me.

If you're interested in learning more about [ppu.toys](http://ppu.toys) I made this other video to walk through the features: [https://youtu.be/4NtyIM-2uLM](https://youtu.be/4NtyIM-2uLM)
